text:
maria_ae: Heads-up: Prospect HelixMed wants a short perf validation for their internal triage system. Requirements: 500 rps sustained, average response ~400 tokens, occasional bursts to 1500 rps for 60s. They want: a succinct runbook, exact vegeta/k6 invocations, a hosted vs reserved tally, and a note about KMS latency differences for FIPS workloads. Need this ready by Wed morning for the demo.

devon_se: I'll coordinate. Suggest run profile: 8m warmup @100rps, 12m ramp to 500rps, 20m steady, then 3x 60s bursts at 1500rps spaced 6m. We'll collect p50/p95/p99, error %, and token emission.

harry_eng: Quick perf background: for rwd-30b-quant under similar conditions we saw p50 stream start ~120ms @256 tokens, scale to ~160-200ms for 400 tokens. Token throughput for 500rps@400tok ~200k tok/sec. Recommend at least 3 pods on A100-equivalent for steady state depending on continuous batching settings.

harry_eng: Vegeta example (single sustained run):
```
vegeta attack -duration=00m20s -rate=500 -targets=helix_targets.txt | vegeta report -type=json > helix_500rps.json
```
And for bursts: `-rate=1500 -duration=00m01m` three times with cool-down periods in between.

zoe_ops: Ops checklist:
- Provision a staging token for Helix test client.
- Deploy rwd-30b-quant to a staging pool in us-east-1 with at least 4 replicas.
- Ensure metrics exporter is enabled and collecting per-pod GPU util every 5s.
- Mark the run in the console to correlate token counts.

claire_sec: KMS/FIPS note: AWS KMS envelope unwrap cost ~2-6ms once warmed; HSM/FIPS setups can add 8-25ms depending on attestation. For strict FIPS requirements we generally recommend private deployment and dedicated HSM or bringing-your-own-HSM. I'll attach a short paragraph for the customer.

cost-bot: rough: Hosted PoC (1 hour with bursts) likely in the low thousands USD depending on model chosen. Dedicated pool to support 500rps steady with bursts: estimated reserved commit $20k-$55k/mo depending on instance family. I'll provide a small spreadsheet after Mike confirms exact gpu counts.

maria_ae: Can Harry post a quick note on expected GPU count before EOD? AE needs a ballpark to include in the deck.

harry_eng: Ballpark: assuming continuous batching and rwd-30b-quant, 3-5 A100-equivalent GPUs. For rwd-70b-quant probably 6-10. I'll run a short calibration by tomorrow and post precise numbers.

devon_se: Runbook checklist (I'll own execution):
- Prep: targets file, auth token, and env var for metrics export.
- Warmup: 8m @100rps.
- Ramp: 12m ramp to 500rps.
- Steady: 20m capture.
- Bursts: 3x 60s @1500rps spaced 6m apart.
- Data collection: vegeta JSON, grafana p95/p99, pod GPU traces, and token counts.
- Post-run: short writeup with recommended sizing and cost options.

maria_ae: Action items: Devon runs run Mon 09:00 PT, Harry posts calibration by EOD tomorrow, Zoe will provision staging, Claire posts KMS note. Cost-bot to attach rough spreadsheet.

harry_eng: Will include a small harness to randomize prompt lengths between 200-600 tokens to mimic real traffic.

maria_ae: Thanks team 44d
